[SWS_DM_00401] Reading Diagnostic Data Identifier on Data Element level
⌈
If the Diagnostic Server instance is required to read data configured
as DiagnosticDataIdentifier and at least on of the DiagnosticDataEle-
ments aggregated in this DiagnosticDataIdentifier is referenced by some
DiagnosticMapping, then Diagnostic Server instance shall retrieve the
data by reading data from each DiagnosticDataElement separately according to
[SWS_DM_00393] and [SWS_DM_00905].
⌋
